items.title: Bitcoin Climbs Above $80,000
items.summary: Bitcoin broke above $80,000 on Friday, lifting shares of crypto-linked stocks.  The largest cryptocurrency recently traded at $80,587 Friday morning, up more than 5% from its 4 p.m. ET level on Thursday.  The move higher came despite the failure of a major crypto legislation and the Federal Reserve’s first interest-rate hike in three years earlier in the week.
